notes:
Account snapshot and POC notes:
- Company: Petal Arc Systems (mid-market product analytics SaaS). Evaluating hosted API first, then plan to move to Dedicated for predictable throughput + VPC.
- Contacts: CTO (Lisa Chen), Sr. Eng Manager (Mateo Ruiz), Product Head (Hannah K.). Primary AE: Evan Moore. SE: Priya Nair in the loop.
- Timeline:
  * 2026-01-22: Intro call, product fit confirmed (support & search). Fireflies: ff_2026-02-02_821.
  * 2026-02-02: Hosted trial kickoff; test corpus and eval prompts uploaded (drive link).
  * 2026-02-18: Mid-trial sync — early perf looks good, one latency regression on long docs.
  * 2026-03-03: Hosted trial wrap + demo of streaming and function-calling. Fireflies: ff_2026-03-03_144.
  * 2026-03-09: Pricing conversation; AE sent preliminary Dedicated sizing and T-shirt pricing.
- Hosted trial metrics (30-day window):
  * Avg QPS (overall): 4.2 QPS
  * Peak QPS observed (1m): 28 QPS during business hours (APAC spike from internal testing).
  * Typical concurrency during peak: 36 concurrent requests
  * Call mix: ~55% chat/short completions, 30% embeddings (batch semantic-search), 15% reranking/longer generation flows
  * Token mix (avg): prompt 65 tokens, completion 420 tokens -> avg round-trip ~485 tokens; embeddings calls are ~768 dims, average doc size 512 tokens pre-embedding
  * 95th latency on hosted trial (short responses): ~280ms; for long generation flows (>=800 tokens) p95 ~1.9s
  * Errors: transient 429s during an internal stress test (no customer traffic) — mitigated by configuring higher concurrency in SDK. Logged INF-1124.
- Business requirements and constraints:
  * Need predictable monthly unit cost for cost modeling (finance ask).
  * Must support SSO (SAML) and integrate with company KMS for key management.
  * Data residency: EU customer data must remain in EU region (Hannah flagged this).
  * Latency SLO: under 400ms p95 for short chat completions in NA; under 800ms p95 for long completions.
  * Throughput target for Dedicated: plan to provision for steady 20 QPS with headroom to 60 QPS for growth/spikes.
- Dedicated sizing recommendation (SE analysis - 2026-03-07):
  * Based on token mix, avg token size and observed batching benefits for embeddings, suggested reserved capacity: 4 x GPU-class nodes (equivalent to A100-40GB perf tier) with autoscale headroom to 8 nodes for bursts.
  * Concurrency target: reserve capacity for 80 concurrent in-flight requests (accounts for long running generations).
  * QPS reservation: target 50 QPS sustained, supports vertical growth and customer SLA.
  * Notes on batching: embeddings workload benefits from micro-batching; set batch window to 20-40ms to increase throughput without violating latency SLOs.
  * KV/prefix cache: enable for chat flows to reduce repeated prompt cost by ~12% observed in trial traces.
  * Estimated committed monthly cost (ballpark for procurement discussion): $18k - $28k/month depending on node class and discount; annual commit reduces to mid-point.
- Risks & open items:
  * VPC peering: network team needs IP ranges + egress rules (pending).
  * KMS key exchange and wrap/unwrap flows need security review (SEC-947).
  * Need explicit residency guarantee in contract for EU dataset (legal).
  * Performance regression observed on one long-document path — require infra deep-dive during SE call.
- Suggested immediate next steps:
  * Schedule Dedicated sizing deep-dive with infra SEs (aim for 60-90 minute session) to validate node class and autoscale settings.
  * Provide draft Dedicated pricing with 12-month and 36-month commit options.
  * Legal and security to exchange SOC2 artifacts, KMS docs; add to Drive.
  * Follow-up call week of 2026-03-16 to confirm procurement timeline and VPC details.
- Direct quote / customer sentiment: "We like the dev-experience and the telemetry — want cost predictability and a clear dedicated plan so finance can sign off." — Lisa Chen (CTO).
- Internal notes: prioritize confirming EU residency clause; se_assigned to prepare an ops playbook for the POC (network checklist, cert exchange, test vectors).
